tools.name: search_atlas
tools.description: Search AgentAtlas, the verified map of the AI agent stack: setup guides for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and more), official MCP servers, plugin systems, eval frameworks, agent benchmarks and protocols. Every entry is sourced from vendor docs.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get a full sourced setup guide (settings, commands, config files) by slug, as Markdown with source links.

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: Get install commands for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and VS Code, plus tools and auth details, for an official MCP server by slug.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get coding agent plans and prices copied from vendor pricing pages. Optional harness slug, e.g. 'cursor' or 'claude-code'.
